name: Ecchi na Douki wa Suki Desu ka? ~Boku wa Kanojo o Nugasete Sodateru~
original_name: えっちな同期は好きですか？ ～僕は彼女を脱がせて育てる～
source:
Now you can be a porn director too! No experience necessary!

"I probably won't get accepted anyway, but it's better than doing nothing."

That's what Tsukuba Ichirou, a young man struggling to find a job, thought when he applied. But for some reason, he was offered an adult video director position.

On his first day of work, he meets aspiring porn star Amai Kokona, a new employee who was hired at the same time as him. An encounter that would change both of their lives completely.

"Hehe, you don't have to be so stiff around me. We're the same seniority level, right?"

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2650850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
现在你也可以成为一名色情导演！无需经验！

“无论如何，我可能不会被接受，但这比什么都不做要好。”

正在努力找工作的年轻人筑波一郎在申请时也是这么想的。但由于某种原因，他获得了成人视频导演的职位。

上班第一天，他遇到了有抱负的色情明星阿麦·科科纳，一位与他同时入职的新员工。一次邂逅彻底改变了他们两人的生活。

“呵呵，你不用在我面前这么僵硬，我们是同辈的吧？”

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2650850/]Steam[/url]]
